name: Wild Strawberry

facts.where: Woodland edges and meadows of far East Texas

caution: True wild strawberry has white flowers and red fruit; the harmless 'mock strawberry' has yellow flowers and a bland fruit. Neither is dangerous, but know the difference. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A miniature of the garden berry, low to the ground with white five-petal flowers. The fruit is a fraction of the size and many times the flavor.

sections.title: On the trail
sections.body: Too small and scattered to gather in bulk, but the most intense strawberry you will ever taste, eaten on the spot.
